reasons.claim: The chain is Asim, then Muhammad b. Qays, then the Imam written after «عن», whose saying follows «قال»; both readers have exactly this.
reasons.quote: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ

reasons.claim: The last level is two alternatives joined by «أو», as the readers have it.
reasons.quote: عن ابن عباس، أو أبي هريرة

reasons.claim: Abd al-Razzaq's remark only explains Ma'mar's alternation and adds no transmitter.
reasons.quote: قال عبد الرزاق كان معمر أحيانا يقول

reviews.question: the author of a rescript from an Imam: the report relays a letter Amir al-Mu'minin wrote to his officials

reasons.claim: After al-Nawfali the chain is raised with a gap to Ja'far b. Muhammad, then his forefathers.
reasons.quote: النوفلى رفعه إلى جعفر بن محمد أنه ذكر عن آبائه

reasons.claim: The words relayed are Amir al-Mu'minin's letter, so he is the last link, named after the chain; if the rescript question went the other way only the last link's status would change, not the order of the rest.
reasons.quote: أن أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام كتب إلى عماله

reviews.uncertainty_note: The owner has not ruled on the author of a rescript; the structure otherwise follows the text.

reasons.claim: The chain runs to Ibn Abbas, whom the stored chain omits; the readers include him correctly.
reasons.quote: عن سعيد بن جبير، عن ابن عباس، في هذه القصة

reasons.claim: The archive's chronology flags concern identity, not the written order, which the readers follow.
reasons.quote: حدثني يعلى، عن سعيد بن جبير

reasons.claim: The single chain ends at Anas.
reasons.quote: عن الجعد بن عثمان، عن أنس بن مالك

reasons.claim: «قال الجعد قال أنس» near the end resumes Anas's words within the same report and adds no route; the closing note is the compiler's comment.
reasons.quote: قال الجعد قال أنس أنا أحدث الناس عهدا

reasons.claim: Al-Husayn narrates from his father, who narrates from al-Ash'ari.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه قال: حدثني محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الاشعري

reasons.claim: «باسناده يعرفعه إلى» is a gap before the Imam whose saying follows, so an unnamed link then Abu Abd Allah is right.
reasons.quote: باسناده يعرفعه إلى أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال

reasons.claim: Ibn al-Zubayr narrates from his aunt, written as a relation, who quotes the Prophet; she is the last link and the gloss is not a link.
reasons.quote: يقول حدثتني خالتي، - يعني عائشة - قالت

reasons.claim: The first level holds Ali b. al-Husayn and an unnamed group as co-transmitters.
Abu al-Samit heard the Imam, whose words follow, so the Imam is the last link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِي الصَّامِتِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

reviews.question: format: connecting chain after the names: the whole route is al-Tirmidhi, Ali b. Hujr, Ali b. Mushir, al-A'mash, Abu Salih, then Abu Hurayra or Abu Sa'id (two routes); «حدثنا بذلك» joins the compiler to the isnad stated first.

reasons.claim: The opening «وروى علي بن مسهر» is not the compiler's own hearing; the connecting chain is written after it.
reasons.quote: حدثنا بذلك، علي بن حجر حدثنا علي بن مسهر، عن الأعمش، فذكر نحوه

reasons.claim: The readers make a route from the compiler straight to Ali b. Mushir and a separate route stopping at al-A'mash; both misrepresent one connected chain ending at the two Companions.
reasons.quote: عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، وأبي، سعيد

reasons.claim: Dawud b. Sirhan narrates from the Imam written after «عن»; «جميعا» is in the saying and marks no route.
reasons.quote: وَ رَوَى دَاوُدُ بْنُ سِرْحَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ
